research_question: Does the evidence support a systemic momentum unwind as of 2022-08-19, including material contrary evidence?

sources.title: Desk commentary warns of momentum liquidation
sources.text: A trading-desk note described violent selling in several popular momentum names and called the move systemic. The note supplied no universe-level breadth calculation.

sources.title: Audited factor study finds narrow reversal
sources.text: The audited universe showed reversal in only 38 percent of securities, below the study's systemic threshold. Sector-neutral momentum remained positive and the apparent loss was concentrated in two industries.

sources.title: Fund flows show selective de-risking
sources.text: Reported selling was elevated in technology and consumer discretionary portfolios but neutral in the other measured sectors.

sources.title: Volatility curve changes shape
sources.text: The volatility curve flattened ahead of a central-bank symposium.
